proof:
Source: parent proof step 3, first identity (Simon, proof of Ch. 5, Lemma 2.1, display (2): Σ_{i>n} e^{ii} = ½Σ_{i,j}(e^{ij} − ε^{ij})² = ½|p_{T_xM} − p_{ℝⁿ}|², which uses e^{ij} = e^{ji}, e² = e and trace e = n; book/chapter-05.txt, lines 236–245). Let p := p_T, s := p_S and m := dim T = dim S.

1. p and s are symmetric (⟨pu, v⟩ = ⟨u, pv⟩, ⟨su, v⟩ = ⟨u, sv⟩ for all u, v) and idempotent (p∘p = p, s∘s = s); these are the defining properties of orthogonal projections (Mathlib: Submodule.inner_starProjection_left_eq_right, Submodule.isIdempotentElem_starProjection).
2. trace p = dim T and trace s = dim S. Indeed p = ι∘π, where π : ℝ^P → T is the orthogonal projection onto T and ι : T → ℝ^P the inclusion; by cyclicity of the trace, trace(ι∘π) = trace(π∘ι) = trace(id_T) = dim T, because π∘ι = id_T. The same argument applies to s.
3. For every linear A on ℝ^P, trace A = Σ_i ⟨e_i, A e_i⟩, because (e_i) is an orthonormal basis (Mathlib: LinearMap.trace_eq_sum_inner with EuclideanSpace.basisFun, whose i-th vector is EuclideanSpace.single i 1).
4. Put D := p − s. By step 1, D is symmetric, so for every i, ‖p e_i − s e_i‖² = ⟨D e_i, D e_i⟩ = ⟨e_i, D(D e_i)⟩. Summing and using step 3: Σ_i ‖p e_i − s e_i‖² = trace(D∘D).
5. By step 1, D∘D = p∘p − p∘s − s∘p + s∘s = p + s − p∘s − s∘p. By linearity of the trace, cyclicity trace(s∘p) = trace(p∘s), and step 2: trace(D∘D) = dim T + dim S − 2 trace(p∘s) = 2m − 2 trace(p∘s) (here dim T = dim S = m is used).
6. Since p∘(I − s) = p − p∘s, step 2 gives trace(p∘(I − s)) = m − trace(p∘s).
7. Steps 4–6 give Σ_i ‖p e_i − s e_i‖² = 2m − 2 trace(p∘s) = 2 trace(p∘(I − s)); dividing by 2 yields trace(p_T∘(I − p_S)) = ½ Σ_i |p_T e_i − p_S e_i|². ∎

theorem Submission.dorag_th_trace_proj_comp_compl : ∀ (P : ℕ) (T S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ T = Module.finrank ℝ S → LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (T.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) - S.starProjection).toLinearMap) = 1 / 2 * ∑ i : Fin P, ‖T.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2 := by
  intro P T S hTS
  have htr : ∀ K : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P),
      LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) K.starProjection.toLinearMap = (Module.finrank ℝ K : ℝ) := by
    intro K
    rw [Submodule.starProjection, ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_comp, LinearMap.trace_comp_comm']
    have hcomp : K.orthogonalProjectionOnto.toLinearMap.comp K.subtypeL.toLinearMap = LinearMap.id := by
      ext x
      simp
    rw [hcomp, LinearMap.trace_id]
  set p : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P := T.starProjection
  set s : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P := S.starProjection
  have hp_symm : ∀ u w : Euclid P, inner ℝ (p u) w = inner ℝ u (p w) :=
    fun u w => T.inner_starProjection_left_eq_right u w
  have hs_symm : ∀ u w : Euclid P, inner ℝ (s u) w = inner ℝ u (s w) :=
    fun u w => S.inner_starProjection_left_eq_right u w
  have hpp : p.comp p = p := T.isIdempotentElem_starProjection
  have hss : s.comp s = s := S.isIdempotentElem_starProjection
  let b := EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ
  -- Σ‖(p-s)eᵢ‖² = trace((p-s)∘(p-s))
  have hsum : ∑ i : Fin P, ‖p (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - s (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2 =
      LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((p - s).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (p - s).toLinearMap) := by
    rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_sum_inner _ b]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    have hb : b i = EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) := by simp [b]
    rw [hb]
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply]
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    have : ∀ u w : Euclid P, inner ℝ ((p - s) u) w = inner ℝ u ((p - s) w) := by
      intro u w
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right, hp_symm, hs_symm]
    rw [← this]
    simp [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
  have hexp : (p - s).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (p - s).toLinearMap =
      p.toLinearMap + s.toLinearMap - p.toLinearMap ∘ₗ s.toLinearMap - s.toLinearMap ∘ₗ p.toLinearMap := by
    have h1 : p.toLinearMap ∘ₗ p.toLinearMap = p.toLinearMap := by
      rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_comp, hpp]
    have h2 : s.toLinearMap ∘ₗ s.toLinearMap = s.toLinearMap := by
      rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_comp, hss]
    ext u
    have e1 := congrArg (fun f : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P => f u) h1
    have e2 := congrArg (fun f : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P => f u) h2
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply] at e1 e2
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, map_sub, e1, e2]
    abel
  have hcomm : LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (s.toLinearMap ∘ₗ p.toLinearMap) =
      LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (p.toLinearMap ∘ₗ s.toLinearMap) := LinearMap.trace_comp_comm' _ _
  have hlhs : T.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) - S.starProjection).toLinearMap =
      p.toLinearMap - p.toLinearMap ∘ₗ s.toLinearMap := by
    ext u
    simp [p, s, map_sub]
  rw [hlhs, hsum, hexp, map_sub, map_sub, map_sub, map_add, hcomm]
  have hp : LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) p.toLinearMap = (Module.finrank ℝ T : ℝ) := htr T
  have hs' : LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) s.toLinearMap = (Module.finrank ℝ S : ℝ) := htr S
  rw [hp, hs', hTS]
  ring
